title: 세탁소에 옷 맡기기: 이것 좀 지워 주세요
objective: You can ask a Korean dry cleaner to clean, remove stains or shorten clothes with -어 주세요.
summary: Practice a dry-cleaner conversation with -어 주세요.
setting: A neighborhood dry cleaner (세탁소). A customer brings in a coat with a coffee stain and a pair of pants that are too long.

task.title: Make requests at the cleaner
task.line: Use the dialogue and word list to fill in, choose or write the Korean.

words.meaning: to drop off (for cleaning or repair)
words.exampleMeaning: I dropped off three shirts at the cleaner.
I got a kimchi stain on my white shirt.
Wine stains are hard to get out.
I had the waist of my pants taken in by 2 cm.
After work, I picked up my suit from the cleaner.

words.example: 영수증을 잃어버렸는데 옷을 찾을 수 있어요?
words.exampleMeaning: I lost my receipt. Can I still pick up my clothes?

dialogue.korean: 네. 어, 여기 소매에 얼룩이 있네요.
dialogue.meaning: Sure. Oh, there's a stain here on the sleeve.

dialogue.korean: 아, 커피를 쏟았어요. 얼룩도 좀 지워 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, I spilled coffee. Please remove the stain too.

dialogue.korean: 네, 지워 볼게요. 다른 옷도 있으세요?
dialogue.meaning: Okay, I'll try to get it out. Do you have any other clothes?

dialogue.korean: 이 바지는 너무 길어요. 3센티쯤 줄여 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: These pants are too long. Please shorten them by about 3 cm.

dialogue.korean: 네, 수선도 같이 해 드릴게요. 금요일 오후에 찾으러 오세요.
dialogue.meaning: Sure, we'll do the alteration as well. Come and pick them up on Friday afternoon.

dialogue.korean: 여기 영수증이요. 찾으러 오실 때 꼭 가져오세요.
dialogue.meaning: Here's your receipt. Make sure to bring it when you come to pick them up.

exercises: Change the verb in brackets to the -어 주세요 form: ① 이 셔츠 좀 ____. (다리다, to iron) ② 단추를 새로 ____. (달다, to sew on) ③ 치마 길이를 좀 ____. (늘리다, to make longer)
Choose the right word: 커피를 쏟아서 하얀 바지에 ( 얼룩 / 영수증 )이 생겼어요.
Your clothes are ready, but the clerk needs a paper from you first. Fill in the blank: 직원: 손님, ____ 있으세요?
Your jacket sleeves are too long. Ask the clerk to shorten them. Write one sentence in Korean.
answers: ① 다려 주세요 ② 달아 주세요 ③ 늘려 주세요
소매 좀 줄여 주세요. (소매를 줄여 주세요. / 소매 길이를 줄여 주세요.)
